final_elements.name: canopy silhouette
final_elements.description: A broad shallow dome with five fixed scallops across its lower edge.

final_elements.name: canopy seams
final_elements.description: Three light pencil ribs radiating from the top center to the four joins between the scallops.

final_elements.name: center shaft
final_elements.description: A straight slender shaft from the canopy center down to a fixed lower endpoint.

final_elements.name: curved wooden hook
final_elements.description: A J-shaped handle curling left from the lower shaft, with its end turned upward.

final_elements.name: top ferrule
final_elements.description: A short pointed tip directly above the canopy center.

final_elements.name: three rain drops
final_elements.description: Three separate teardrops outside the canopy, two on the left and one on the right.

final_elements.name: broken ground shadow
final_elements.description: One loose graphite shadow directly beneath the hooked handle.

frames.instruction: Draw a wide, shallow dome, then close its lower edge with four gentle scallops. Keep the top center and the three scallop joins clear.

frames.visible_job: From the fixed top center, draw three light ribs down to the four joins between the four scallops. Keep the outside edge unchanged.
frames.instruction: From the fixed top center, draw three light ribs down to the three joins between the four scallops. Keep the outside edge unchanged.

frames.visible_job: From beneath the top center, draw a thin straight shaft down through the middle scallop to a point well below the canopy. Keep it centered.
frames.instruction: From beneath the top center, draw a thin straight shaft down through the middle scallop to a point well below the canopy. Leave its rounded lower endpoint ready for the hook to overlap.

frames.visible_job: At the lower shaft, curve a J-shaped wooden handle left and upward. Add a short pointed ferrule above the same canopy center.

frames.visible_job: Add three pale-blue raindrops outside the canopy and a broken graphite shadow beneath the hook.

final_step.visible_job: Add muted red and gold pencil bands across the existing canopy, warm brown to the hook, and deeper graphite without moving any line.
final_step.instruction: Shade the canopy in muted red and gold bands: red on both narrow outer edges and the left center section, gold in the remaining spaces. Color the hook brown, preserve the three pale-blue drops, and deepen selected ribs and shadow without new contours.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The saved first square crop has one complete broad canopy with four scallops at final scale. Its three lower joins give clear landing points for later ribs; no future shaft, tip, drops, or shadow intrude.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I read each instruction against consecutive saved JPG crops. The same four-scallop canopy gains three ribs, then a centered shaft; the hook covers only the reserved shaft endpoint and a ferrule caps the crown. Three drops and a ground shadow arrive before restrained color. No temporary guides are used; no unexplained anchor shift or removal was observed.

transitions.observed_addition: Three ribs now fan from the same crown to the left, middle, and right scallop joins; all four scallops and both canopy tips remain visible.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 2 names the three fixed joins and the saved image shows those exact rib endpoints.

transitions.observed_addition: A narrow vertical shaft meets the middle scallop join and stops below the canopy with a small rounded end. The dome, four scallops, and three ribs remain anchored.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 3 asks for the centered shaft and reserves its lower end for the following overlap.

transitions.observed_addition: The graphite J hook wraps over the former lower shaft tip and curls left; a short ferrule caps the same crown. The canopy endpoints, three ribs, and straight shaft stay fixed.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 4 explicitly covers the reserved shaft endpoint with the hook and places the ferrule on the existing centerline.

transitions.observed_addition: Two pale-blue drops appear outside the left canopy edge and one outside the right, while a broken graphite shadow sits below the hook. The ferrule, four scallops, three ribs, shaft, and J hook persist.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 5 specifies the two-left one-right drop positions and the separate ground shadow.

transitions.observed_addition: Muted red fills both outer canopy edges and the left-center section; gold fills the other spaces. Brown fills the fixed J hook, the three earlier blue drops persist, and the shadow and ribs darken without new structure.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction names the observed color placement and preserves every earlier contour and drop.
